camera_selection: largest coarse prior support then camera-center diversity; train only; no reference or outcome selection
photo_margin_definition: E_prior - E_mvs; positive means lower MVS photo cost on identical pixels and neighbors, not accuracy
delta_definition: D_prior - D_mvs in camera-Z meters on integer RGB rays; positive prior farther from camera
prior_ray_convention: native Open3D u+0.5,v+0.5; positive-valid bilinear query at RGB uv-0.5; holes stay missing
mvs_ray_convention: integer RGB rays mapped via K_native @ inverse(K_RGB), nearest floor(uv+0.5)
profile_model: two source-normal plane branches at varying center camera-Z; common complete patches and neighbors over every hypothesis
